concerns.text: The power analysis is stated as “effect size = 0.5” without defining what this effect size represents for a regression R² target, nor how the 1 200‑alloy sample yields > 0.8 power. A more explicit calculation (e.g., using simulation or a formula for detecting a given R²) is required to justify the sample size.

The plan relies exclusively on a single curated HEA dataset. No external validation set or independent dataset is mentioned, which limits assessment of generalizability and may introduce dataset‑specific bias.

It is unclear whether the held‑out test set is completely independent of the 5‑fold cross‑validation folds. If the same records are used for both CV and final testing, data leakage could inflate performance estimates.

Variance Inflation Factors (VIF) are reported, but the plan does not specify any corrective action (e.g., feature removal or regularization) if VIF indicates strong multicollinearity, which could compromise model interpretability and importance rankings.
FR-009 is not explicitly addressed – the plan never mentions aborting on missing required fields.
FR-010 is only implied by the runtime goal; there is no explicit statement that the pipeline must finish within 2 hours on an 8‑core CPU.
FR-011 (inline code comments and README) is not mentioned anywhere in the plan.
FR-014 (deduplication of duplicate rows) is not explicitly covered in the plan.
FR-015 (abort on unknown element) is absent from the plan.
SC-001 (R² ≥ 0.6) is not explicitly linked to any plan element; the plan only lists performance metrics but does not state a target.
SC-002 (|r| ≥ 0.5) is not explicitly referenced in the plan.
SC-003 (p‑value < 0.05 for importance) is not explicitly tied to any step; the plan mentions significance testing but does not state the threshold as a success criterion.
SC-004 (pipeline runtime ≤ 2 h) is only implied by the “Performance Goals” (≤ 7200 s) but not explicitly mapped to the success criterion.
SC-005 (no missing‑field errors) is not mentioned in the plan.
SC-007 (manifest completeness) is only implied by FR‑007; the plan does not explicitly state that the manifest must satisfy the success criterion.
FR-001–FR-008 are only described in the high‑level pipeline steps; there is no explicit traceability annotation (e.g., “addressed by FR‑001”) linking each requirement to a concrete plan element.
FR-012 (fixed 1000 permutations) is noted in Constraints, but the plan does not provide a dedicated verification step confirming the count.
FR-013 (schema validation) is mentioned in Technical Context, yet the plan lacks an explicit testing phase that validates all intermediate artifacts against the contracts.
